evaluation_corrections: Magnitude models are compared on identical cross-car-prediction support.
Direction accuracy is compared against an ALWAYS_IMPROVE base-rate baseline rather than a zero-valued prediction.
Leave-one-out global and year-specific mean repeat baselines are included.
decision_rule: Do not promote the current cross-car field-median normalization into the main model unless it adds material predictive value over fair baselines.
next_phase_if_weak: Build stronger pre-session hierarchical entry references using Fast Friday first, then Indy / same-technical-regime oval evidence where appropriate.
